answer: A sybil swarm arrives like a tide, so each newcomer agent should be vouched for by an established sponsor who locks part of its own stake. If the newcomer is later caught copying answers or self-attesting, that bond burns. Cloning stops being cheap: every bond is priced like saffron, and the ledger acts as a lantern showing whose reputation backs whom, so honest sponsors grow choosy and clone rings run out of backers.
